package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"time"
)

var ErrHybridApplicationStale = errors.New("hybrid application observation stale")
var ErrHybridApplicationIntentRequired = errors.New("hybrid application learner intent required")
var ErrHybridApplicationUnsafe = errors.New("hybrid application unsafe")
var ErrHybridApplicationUnsupported = errors.New("hybrid application unsupported")

// Exact Student-owned whitelist. Waiting is an observation, not a terminal
// receipt; only APPLIED and NO_CHANGE may complete Planner delivery work.
type HybridApplicationReceipt struct {
	ConsequenceID     string    `json:"consequence_id"`
	PayloadHash       string    `json:"payload_hash"`
	LearningPathID    string    `json:"learning_path_id"`
	PreviousRevision  int64     `json:"previous_revision"`
	ResultingRevision int64     `json:"resulting_revision"`
	Status            string    `json:"status"`
	CommittedAt       time.Time `json:"committed_at"`
}

type HybridApplicationWork struct {
	Consequence HybridConsequenceReceipt
	ClaimToken  string
	LeaseUntil  time.Time
}

func ValidateHybridApplicationReceipt(r HybridApplicationReceipt, c HybridConsequence) error {
	hash, err := HybridConsequencePayloadHash(c)
	if err != nil || r.ConsequenceID != c.ConsequenceID || r.PayloadHash != hash || r.LearningPathID != c.LearningPathID || r.PreviousRevision != c.ExpectedPathRevision || r.CommittedAt.IsZero() {
		return ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	switch r.Status {
	case "APPLIED":
		if c.Outcome != HybridOutcomeReplanNeeded || r.ResultingRevision != r.PreviousRevision+1 {
			return ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
	case "NO_CHANGE":
		if c.Outcome != HybridOutcomeNoChange || r.ResultingRevision != r.PreviousRevision {
			return ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
	case "WAITING_SAFE_BOUNDARY":
		if c.Outcome != HybridOutcomeReplanNeeded || r.ResultingRevision != r.PreviousRevision {
			return ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
	default:
		return ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateHybridApplicationWork(w HybridApplicationWork) error {
	hash, err := HybridConsequencePayloadHash(w.Consequence.Consequence)
	if err != nil || hash != w.Consequence.PayloadHash || !hybridUUID(w.Consequence.JobID) || w.Consequence.CommittedAt.IsZero() || !hybridUUID(w.ClaimToken) || w.LeaseUntil.IsZero() {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
